evidence_items.locator: Abstract, evaluation of advertised hallucination-free legal tools
evidence_items.explanation: The evaluation found substantial remaining hallucinations in retrieval-based legal tools, despite improvements over general-purpose chatbots. This is consistent with the absence of an immediate general fix, but does not establish failure of every possible technique.

The paper presents semantic-entropy methods for detecting a subset of hallucinations across tasks. It demonstrates meaningful progress that qualifies any suggestion of no useful remedies, while stopping short of a general elimination result.

unresolved_gaps: No calendar deadline can be derived from soon or immediate.
